messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT detected: elevated cross-region failovers between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. 30m window: ~18k rerouted requests, p95 latency +2x, error rate +17%. auto-page: @oncall-lee
oncall-lee: ack. I'm awake and on it. paging @emily-sre @mendel-ml @nate-ops. any customer hits?
emily-sre: looking at routing-controller. health probe failures in eu spike around proxy-02 causing fallback to us-west, then us-west marks backend unhealthy and falls back to us-east, then back to eu. loop per request cluster ~4-7 hops.
mendel-ml: checking model rollouts. us-west has canary model-beta:1.3 (small %), eu/us-east on model-stable:1.1. latency delta: beta ~150ms med, stable ~90ms. not huge but could amplify tail when combined with probe flaps.
nate-ops: config note: proxy healthcheck timeout currently 200ms and fail-after=2. eu p95 is 350-700ms during spike windows.
chao-eng: attaching recent proxy GC trace from eu-2: full heap compaction at 12:03 causing 450-800ms pauses.
emily-sre: mitigation plan proposal:
1) temporarily increase healthcheck timeout to 600ms and fail-after to 4
2) add short regional affinity so retries stay in-origin region for 45s
3) deploy a cross-region retry cap = 2
any objections?
mendel-ml: agree with plan. also recommend aborting the beta canary in us-west if flaps continue.
jordan-platform: I'll push a soft circuit-breaker to cap cross-region hops to 2 and add a cooldown. deploying now.

```bash
# apply healthcheck relax and affinity
redwoodctl routing update global-fallback \n  --healthcheck-timeout 600ms \n  --healthcheck-failures 4 \n  --region-affinity 45s \n  --cross-region-retry-limit 2
```

emily-sre: applied config, pushing to control plane (cfg=cfg-b3f9). rolling to proxies (eu/us-west/us-east)...
incidents-bot: config rollout started cfg-b3f9; proxies ack 3/3/3 in progress
nate-ops: restarted proxy-02 on eu cluster (reclaimed memory). GC pauses stop in traces.
mendel-ml: paused canary in us-west (model-beta:1.3) to reduce variance.
sara-support: CS update sent: "We detected transient cross-region routing instability affecting a subset of requests. Mitigations in flight. No customer data exposed. ETA 30m."
oncall-lee: monitoring metrics. error rate trending down from +17% -> +6% within 6m of changes.
emily-sre: eu p95 reduced to ~210ms after proxy restart and config change. us-west stable.
jordan-platform: logs show cross-region hops per request capped at 2; retry storms suppressed.
chao-eng: posting link to collected traces and heap dump: <link-hidden>
mendel-ml: with canary paused and probe threshold relaxed, model latency differences no longer trigger routing churn.
oncall-lee: action items: 1) keep relaxed health timeout for 30m, 2) monitor 20m continuous healthy baseline, 3) schedule full canary sync or rollback window 02:00 UTC, 4) postmortem if recurrence. assigning postmortem to emily-sre.
emily-sre: will own postmortem. collecting routing logs, proxy GC logs, model rollout history, healthprobe traces. upload any local artifacts to /incidents/4532109999/
sara-support: CS classification: P2 (partial degraded availability for subset of requests). customers notified.
incidents-bot: Incident 4532109999 status: mitigated -> monitoring. duration so far: ~37m. postmortem_owner: emily-sre. tags: routing, healthcheck, proxy-gc, model-canary
oncall-lee: closing pager after 30m of steady metrics; reopen if error rate rises. :thumbsup:
